title: Command reference
summary: Useful player commands and where to learn more.
body:
Level-scaled AA — live testing: Earn two AA per level while leveling. From level 1, use the AA +/− buttons to choose 0–100%; 100% pauses leveling so you can grind AA where you prefer. Close EverQuest and update through launcher Play for game 2026102301. Existing points, purchases and partial progress stay intact. AA progression and examples.

Player commands
CommandWhat it does
#classesShow Primary, Second and Third classes. Class guide.
#aaexpCheck your AA percentage. The native AA +/− buttons work from level 1.
#aaexp offSet 0% AA: full leveling experience plus two AA per level from eligible rewards.
#aaexp onSet 100% AA: pause leveling and earn 20 AA per current-level equivalent of eligible experience.
#aaexp 0–100Set an AA percentage directly, for example #aaexp 50. Partial allocations split progression; on/off are aliases for 100/0.
/advlootOpen the custom loot window.
/pet ordersCommand the selected pet or All pets. Check the Commands line in Pet Info.
#instancesShow open private dungeon runs and timers. Instance guide.
#zoneforgeUpgrade matching zone rewards: three Base copies, or four Polished/Exalted copies. Forging guide.
#sellallImmediately sell eligible carried items. Bank valuables first. Selling rules.

Recall is an ability

Make a hotkey for Ancient Attunement in the General abilities tab. It returns you to the tunnel with a five-second cast and ten-minute reuse while preserving your bind point.

High Keep rescue dialogue

Hail the Gate Sergeant to begin the entrance confrontation. After defeating the four bosses, hail Osargen and choose Lead the way. An enrolled player may take over the escort by hailing him and choosing Lead the way. Full instructions.

Player bazaar — live testing

In public East Commonlands, use #bazaar post <price-pp>, #bazaar confirm <nonce>, #bazaar listings, #bazaar cancel <id> and #bazaar collect. Native /bazaar searches the Commonlands market. Native search and buying still need player verification; see posting, buying and item restrictions.

The Sell / My Listings panel is not released. The commands above remain the available posting, cancellation and collection controls.
